gameName: Clank! In! Space!: A Deck-Building Adventure

steps.text: Assemble the ship: Cargo Bay, Command and Corridor always; the other 3 modules in any position, either side up
steps.note: First game: Hydroponics, Doomsday Cannon, Med Lab as shown

steps.text: Artifacts faceup on the matching numbered Command spaces{x}
Shuffle the Major Secrets; 1 on each Major Secret space
Shuffle the Minor Secrets; 2 on each Minor Secret space; box extras unseen
Market Board by the ship with {n} each of Contraband, Master Key, Med Kit and TelePass
4 Escape Pod tokens in the Cargo Bay
Bank: 5 Power Crystals, {n} Command Code tokens and all Credits
4 red Bounty Hunter cubes: one on each of the first two red-zone spaces, two on the plaid space
Blockade token on the last space of the red zone
Boss Marker on the space for {n} players
24 black boss cubes in the Boss Bag
Reserve: G:B-L1N plus the FAZR, Boldly Go and Memory Core piles
Shuffle the Adventure Deck; deal {n} faceup as the Adventure Row, replacing any with the Boss Attack symbol (reshuffle those)
Each player: a pawn, 30 Clank! cubes and 2 Data cubes of their color
Starting deck: 6 Hacks, 2 Stumbles, 1 Access, 1 Scramble
Pawns on the starting space in the Cargo Bay; shuffle and draw 5
Starting Clank! in the Clank! area: 1st player 3, 2nd 2, 3rd 1, 4th 0
The sneakiest player (or a random one) goes first; play is clockwise
